body:
PRD draft 2: accept for chief disposition. C1–C5, rebuilt R2 (not from a SpanSet hull), R4.8 uncalibrated-must-not-Accept, courted R10, deepened R11, M1b, Q-C.

One residual, already measured: R4.6 and R11 still collide if identity binds EvidenceBundle.proposals / LedgerEntry’s Vector. Canonicalizing only the Accepted evidence union leaves the larger order-sensitive door open. Two records, not a quieter R4.6:

- RAW ACQUISITION TRACE may keep arrival order for audit. It is not evidence and cannot select a cut.
- CANONICAL SCIENTIFIC PROJECTION contains every proposal, finding, calibration, and call-group fact, ordered by stable content or receipt keys. Resolver state and construction identity bind to this projection.

Court R11 requires equality of projection, resolved state, construction identity, and output. The raw trace is the intentional negative control and may differ.

I still will not take Q-A or Q-B. I still will not start R1 or R11 without a chief ack and a bead. Sinkhorn remains held; I am not claiming M1.
